comment: The qemu-wasm engine and the migration snapshot, built out of band (docs/engine.md) and published by tools/publish-engine.py under a dated release tag that is never reused, so the pins of any commit keep resolving. Pinned by hash so `nix build .#site` produces the whole deployable tree, engine included.
guestComment: The guest image vm.state was captured from. A snapshot holds that kernel and initramfs in its RAM and only resumes on the machine described in machine.json, so a guest built from different sources will not resume against it; checks.snapshot fails when these drift. Retake the snapshot (docs/engine.md) and update these together.
